metadata.gm_saturn_source: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/sats/phys_par/sep.html (SAT441 solution); canonical Jacobson 2006 value 3.7931187e7 differs by 19 km^3/s^2 (within quoted uncertainty)
metadata.notes: All 9 major Saturnian moons, elements from the SAT441 ephemeris on JPL's Planetary Satellite Mean Elements page. Columns: a (km), e, argument of periapsis (deg), mean anomaly at epoch (deg), inclination (deg), longitude of ascending node (deg), orbital period (days) — all referred to each satellite's local Laplace plane, NOT the J2000 ecliptic (see the referenced hotearth doc §1a). Phoebe is included in the same SAT441 solution (code 609), so no separate irregular-satellite source needed. All GM and mean-radius values are published; nothing null. period_days is the mean orbital period column (P).
